channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PF encontra sala secreta para guardar dinheiro em hangar usado por amigo de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz jornal
item.description: Federal Police found a secret room in a hangar at Brasília International Airport, used by aviation companies of lawyer Willer Tomaz, friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, to store cash and a bill-counting machine.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede cassação da candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro por "interferência" da Meta
item.description: Lula's campaign requested the election court to annul Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy due to alleged interference by Meta before the runoff. The accusation seeks to disqualify the opponent for electoral irregularities.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira quer ser ministro de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Ciro Nogueira (PP), defeated in the Senate race, aims to become a minister under Flávio Bolsonaro if he wins the 2026 elections. His vice-presidential bid was jeopardized by a PF investigation linked to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Despite this, his federation endorsed Flávio in the second round.

item.title: Em busca dos alienados
item.description: The 2026 presidential election concludes with an unprecedented scenario: the winner must convince those who did not vote in the first round, especially to vote for him rather than the opponent. Lula needs to surpass Flávio Bolsonaro in the final stretch, according to the latest Vox Populi poll, which shows improved perception of his government.

item.title: Em novo programa, Lula mira indecisos e critica oposição
item.description: Lula’s campaign criticizes the Bolsonaro government and presents economic and social proposals to attract undecided voters, such as tax cuts on basic goods and protection for the Farmácia Popular program. The ads also touch on public security and firearms, using a symbolic scene about rising gun ownership and family risks.

item.title: Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro: o que diz a pesquisa Quaest sobre o 2º turno - O Assunto #1830
item.description: The Quaest poll for the runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), at 45%, and Lula (PT), at 44%. The percentage of undecided voters doubled to 14%, with high rejection rates: 52% for Flávio and 47% for Lula. The rise in undecided voters and electoral alienation may determine the outcome of Sunday’s (25th) election.

item.title: Lula e Flávio prometem tudo, como se dinheiro brotasse do nada
item.description: In the final stretch, Lula and Flávio expand economic pledges without detailing funding sources, worsening fiscal challenges. Neither candidate explains how to fulfill promises within an already strained budget. The race for votes may heighten criticism over the feasibility of their proposals.

item.title: Lula diz que PF apura perda de ilha de Richarlison para amigo de Flávio
item.description: President Lula called for an investigation into the loss of Richarlison's $10 million mansion, which transferred from the footballer to lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, amid allegations of judicial irregularities.

item.title: TSE come poeira dos algoritmos
item.description: The 2026 electoral race is facing criticism over alleged algorithm interference from big tech companies, particularly Meta, in the Brazilian electoral process. The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is investigating suspicions of manipulation by foreign platforms, raising concerns about the integrity of the election.

item.title: Presidente da República: o que faz, quanto ganha e quais são os requisitos para ocupar o cargo?
item.description: The President of the Republic is the head of the federal Executive Branch, elected for a four-year term with the possibility of re-election, and serves as both head of state and head of government. Among their duties are coordinating national policies, appointing ministers, and setting the government agenda. The 2026 election runoff was contested between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Datafolha divulga nova pesquisa presidencial nesta quinta-feira (22)
item.description: Datafolha releases the penultimate 2026 presidential poll, showing a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT). Commissioned by Globo and Folha, the survey interviewed 2,154 people from October 20-22, with a ±2% margin of error and 95% confidence.

item.title: Quaest, 2º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, renda, cor e religião
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 21 shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (45%) and Lula (44%) in the second round, with a two-point margin of error. Conducted for Globo between October 17 and 20 with 2,154 voters, the survey maintained 9% blank, null, and undecided votes, revealing 52% rejection of Bolsonaro versus 47% for Lula.

item.title: Eleição presidencial bate recorde com mais de 800 ações judiciais
item.description: The legal battle between the campaigns of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the election runoff set a record with over 804 lawsuits at the TSE, raising debates on technology, deepfakes, and social media usage.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Datafolha para o segundo turno entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll shows data for the runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula, with 2,520 interviews and a two-point margin of error. The survey was conducted after the Band TV debate and released by Globo and Folha de S.Paulo. Voting intentions indicate a technical tie between the two candidates.

item.title: ‘Experiência’, ‘pareceres’ e serviço 'regular': o que clientes de Flávio dizem sobre contratação de escritório
item.description: Clients of Flávio Bolsonaro's law firm confirmed hiring services during his Senate term, emphasizing technical criteria and regularity in service provision. Invoices total R$ 13.7 million, justified by private legal consulting and opinions.

item.title: Quando o novo teto do MEI passa a valer? E o perdão de dívidas? Tire suas dúvidas
item.description: President Lula signed a law updating the MEI revenue cap from R$81,000 to R$110,000 in 2027 and R$140,000 in 2028, allowing hiring up to two employees and granting full debt forgiveness for MEIs with the federal government. The measure is part of the Prospera MEI package and has an estimated fiscal impact of R$3.38 billion in 2029.

item.title: Desenrola: a três dias do 2º turno, Fazenda faz primeiro chamamento a credores do programa de renegociação de dívidas
item.description: The Ministry of Finance launches the first call for creditors to report debts of individuals and MEIs under Desenrola Brasil 3.0, expecting R$ 90 billion in debts. Announced three days before the runoff, the program allows the government to purchase debt portfolios with discounts ranging from 90% to 97%, aiding debtors with debts up to R$ 10,000.

item.title: Lula suspende atividades de rua para priorizar preparação para debate
item.description: Lula suspends street activities to prepare for TV Globo debate, rehearsing responses and preserving voice after canceling an interview due to hoarseness. The campaign prioritizes offensive strategies against Flávio Bolsonaro, focusing on investigations and asset growth.

item.title: O que resta ao Fluminense? Veja o caminho no Brasileiro para voltar à Libertadores em 2027
item.description: Eliminated from the Libertadores, Fluminense must secure one of the top four positions in the Brazilian Championship to compete in 2027. Currently fifth with 51 points, the club has seven rounds to catch leaders Athletico and Cruzeiro, against whom they play in the final round. Classification depends directly on the results of upcoming matches against teams in the middle and relegation zones.

item.title: Lula faz convite a Flávio para abrir sigilos nesta 5ª feira no TSE
item.description: Lula invited Flávio Bolsonaro to open their financial and personal records at the TSE on Thursday, following the latter's acceptance of the challenge proposed during the first 2nd-round debate. Lula authorized the release of his own banking, fiscal, and phone records, conditioning the move on Flávio's reciprocal proposal, which expanded the request to include relatives and former aides.

item.title: “Vira pix”: Durigan rebate Flávio e diz que proposta já existe
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan responded to Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) statements, asserting that the 'Vira Pix' proposal is already included in the tax reform law, which introduces a cashback program for low-income families starting in 2027. Durigan emphasized that the initiative automatically returns part of the taxes paid on daily purchases via Pix. Flávio proposed an additional refund through Caixa Econômica Federal, but failed to specify costs, beneficiaries, or timelines.

item.title: CNBB cobra respeito às urnas e participação consciente no 2º turno
item.description: The National Conference of Bishops of Brazil (CNBB) released a letter urging respect for the vote and the Constitution in the 2026 runoff elections. The bishops denounce voter coercion and call for responsible participation, monitoring of public managers, and social demands such as work, health, education, housing and security. The CNBB also advises voters to assess the trajectory and pro-democracy commitments of the candidates.

item.title: Lula pode ser 'varrido' em breve por onda de direita na América Latina, diz revista americana
item.description: A column in The New Yorker suggests President Lula could lose to Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 runoff, aligning with a broader rightward shift in Latin America. The article highlights Flávio's unexpected first-round performance and the historical trend of front-runners winning. Despite Lula's social achievements, his re-election chances appear uncertain amid right-wing dominance in Congress and state governments.

item.title: O que será do Ministério da Cultura nos possíveis governos de Flávio ou Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign economic coordinator, Daniella Marques, receives questions about the future of the Ministry of Culture if the senator wins the 2026 election. With 51% voting intentions against Lula's 49%, according to Datafolha, the cultural sector awaits policy definitions. The issue stands out as a concern among voters and artists.

item.title: MPE diz que Meta descumpriu parte das determinações do TSE, aponta novo tratamento desigual em campanhas e pede multa
item.description: The Electoral Prosecutor's Office claims Meta failed to comply with part of the TSE's rulings, especially regarding AI use in content and ad management. Lula's campaign reports distortions in automatic translations of comments, reversing criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro. The PGE seeks a fine for non-compliance and raises concerns about unequal treatment in campaigns.

item.title: Campanha de Lula entra com ação no TSE para cassar chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a motion with the TSE to disqualify Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket, alleging abuse of economic power and improper use of communication channels. The case was assigned to Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Curva, with no deadline set for a ruling. Meta denies providing benefits to any candidate.

item.title: Fotos revelam viagem de Lulinha e lobista em jatinho de US$ 20 mi
item.description: Photos reveal that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, traveled with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger on private jets and met with businesspeople, raising suspicions of influence peddling. The Federal Police are investigating possible deals intermediated by Luchsinger with Lulinha's support, based on messages and images published by Veja magazine.

item.title: Flávio faz campanha em São Paulo; Lula teve ato em Belo Horizonte
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held campaign events in São Paulo, Belo Horizonte, and Fortaleza, addressing issues such as banking secrecy and social policies. Throughout the day, the two candidates exchanged accusations regarding transparency of the sealed documents, while Lula criticized Flávio for 'rigging' the negotiations. Flávio conditioned the release of his sealed documents to expanding the scope of the investigation into Lula's data.

item.title: PSB e PDT anunciam apoio à reeleição de Hugo Motta à Presidência da Câmara dos Deputados
item.description: PSB and PDT announce support for Hugo Motta's reelection as President of the Chamber of Deputies, emphasizing the need for institutional stability and democratic dialogue. The parties justify the support based on Motta's management, which they consider positive for governability and the defense of democratic institutions. The announcement occurs at a time of growth of the far-right in the Legislative House.

item.title: O principal sinal da penúltima pesquisa Quaest sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula antes do segundo turno
item.description: The latest Quaest poll before the runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula shows a technical tie (45% vs 44%) and a sharp rise in voter indecision among independents, who moved from 13% to 31% in spontaneous voting intention. According to Quaest's director of intelligence, the surge in undecided voters reflects difficulty in choosing a candidate in the final stretch but does not signal a major shift in the electoral landscape. While increased indecision might raise abstention, the competitiveness of the race could also boost turnout.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede cassação da chapa de Flávio Bolsonaro em ação sobre atuação da Meta nas eleições
item.description: Lula's campaign requests the annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket for alleged abuse of economic power and misuse of digital platforms, such as Meta and X, favoring the candidacy. The lawsuit also seeks an eight-year ban on Flávio, claiming restrictions on the reach of Lula's campaign content.

item.title: Leia todas as 19 exigências de Flávio para abrir sigilo como Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a petition with the TSE containing 19 conditions to open his privacy seals, responding to Lula's challenge during a debate on Band. The proposal includes authorization to disclose banking, fiscal, and phone privacy seals of his family and companies, plus demands to break seals of Lula's relatives and associates.

item.title: Defensoria aciona STF para obrigar transporte gratuito no 2º turno
item.description: The Public Defender's Office of the Union (DPU) filed a motion with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) requesting that states, municipalities, and the electoral courts be ordered to provide free public transportation during the second round of elections, scheduled for Sunday, the 25th. At least 78 city halls have stated they will not ensure fare-free transport nor maintain regular bus service. The lawsuit aims to guarantee voting rights, particularly for low-income voters.

item.title: Manifesto na USP defende independência dos Três Poderes
item.description: Over 700 personalities, including former STF ministers and ex-governors, read a manifesto at USP defending the independence of the Three Powers and constitutional respect. The document avoids naming Lula and Bolsonaro but warns against power concentration. The event, organized by academic and civil society groups, reinforced checks and balances in democracy.

item.title: Nunes Marques dá prazo para Flávio e aliados apagarem 20 conteúdos sobre Lula
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the removal of 20 publications by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and allied parliamentarians about Lula following a court ruling favorable to the PT coalition. The removal deadline was set at three hours.

item.title: Não é petista, é mãe: o voto de Angélica fala por milhões de mulheres
item.description: Angélica's video, stating she is not a PT supporter nor right-wing but voting for Lula, reflects the central role of women in the 2026 election amid reduced polarization. Support from figures tied to Luciano Huck's circle, including his mother, signals a traditionally right-leaning sector reconsidering its choices. Lula's candidacy gains momentum with female voters who prioritize issues like security, childhood, and minority rights.

item.title: O que as últimas pesquisas eleitorais divulgadas mostram?
item.description: Five polls released show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula with minor variations within the margin of error. The general trend indicates fluctuations in support levels without a clear frontrunner. Comparisons should be interpreted cautiously due to changes in sampling design after the first round.

item.title: Exclusivo: governador eleito de MG fala sobre Flávio, Lula e dívida
item.description: The elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), in an exclusive interview with columnist Ricardo Kertzman, supports Flávio Bolsonaro and counters right-wing criticism regarding negotiations with Davi Alcolumbre to end the 6×1 scale. He also responds to Lula, who claimed Minas needs him to be rebuilt, and discusses the state's billion-dollar debt.

item.title: Com André Fernandes, Flávio é recebido por multidão para ato em Fortaleza
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a rally in Fortaleza with significant crowd turnout, sharing images on social media. The Quaest survey shows a technical tie between Flávio (45%) and Lula (44%) nationally, but Lula leads strongly in the Northeast (61% vs 31%). The runoff takes place on Sunday with 43.5 million voters in the region. The event featured support from André Fernandes and Alcides Fernandes, demonstrating strong PL mobilization in the Northeast.

item.title: Willer Tomaz rebate Richarlison e diz que jogador comprou ilha de “invasor”
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz responded to footballer Richarlison's claim about a mansion on Ilha Comprida allegedly being returned to PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing that the property was purchased from an 'invader'. The case involves a dispute over the legality of land transfer in a residential area. Tomaz defends the validity of his client's purchase, while Richarlison questions the origin of the property.

item.title: Estadão tem postagens sobre eleições censuradas pela Meta e recorre ao TSE
item.description: The newspaper O Estado de S. Paulo filed a lawsuit with the TSE to prevent Meta from removing journalistic posts published on Facebook and Instagram, after 31 articles were reportedly deleted without justification during the election period. They claim none of the posts constituted electoral advertising or improperly used artificial intelligence.

item.title: Edinho afirma que campanha de Lula está “muito convencida” de vitória
item.description: Edinho Silva, campaign coordinator for Lula, stated that the team is 'very convinced' of winning the 2026 second round, despite polls showing a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro. He emphasized campaign growth in the streets and public opinion, highlighting proposals for continuity without loss of social rights.

item.title: CNBB divulga "mensagem ao povo brasileiro" antes do 2º turno. Leia íntegra
item.description: The Brazilian Bishops' Conference (CNBB) released a message to the Brazilian people ahead of the second round of elections, reaffirming respect for the electoral results and advocating for the Constitution, the Democratic State of Law, and conscientious voter participation. The document emphasizes public policies on dignified work, food, housing, health, education, security, and environmental protection, while warning against corruption and voter coercion.

item.title: Entenda polêmica entre Richarlison, Flávio Bolsonaro e Willer Tomaz sobre posse de ilha em Angra
item.description: Richarlison accuses Flávio Bolsonaro and Willer Tomaz of illegal occupation of an island in Angra dos Reis, which the politicians deny. The legal battle has lasted since 2020 and involves money laundering charges against them. The player demands return of the property after losing court cases.

item.title: O Exército do Lula no WhatsApp pode decidir o segundo turno?
item.description: Arilton Freres, CEO of Instituto Indexa, discusses on Papo Antagonista the influence of 'Exército do Lula', a WhatsApp group with millions of subscribers led by André Janones, highlighting the PT's digital mobilization in the runoff as unprecedented. He also comments on the absence of a hidden vote in the final stretch.

item.title: Manifestantes colocam cartaz de "fora, Lula" durante ato do petista em BH
item.description: At a campaign rally in Belo Horizonte, opposing protesters hung a banner demanding Lula and the PT leave, while supporters packed the avenue with signs, balloons and the 'Eu acredito' chant, highlighting polarization in the Minas Gerais runoff.

item.title: Lula ainda pode virar? O que os números da Indexa realmente mostram
item.description: A Indexa poll released four days before the runoff shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 51% of valid votes against Lula's 49%. Institute CEO Arilton Freres told Papo Antagonista that Lula has little room to grow and that poor government evaluations weigh against re-election. While the gap is tight, a reversal is still possible depending on turnout and undecided voters.

item.title: Marqueteiro de Lula negocia checagem em tempo real no debate da “Globo”
item.description: The Minister of the Secretariat for Strategic Affairs, Sidônio Palmeira, discusses with TV Globo the implementation of real-time fact-checking during the presidential debate on October 23rd. The proposal involves publishing checks on g1 without integrating them into the live broadcast. Sidônio advocates for instant verification of statements to combat misinformation.

item.title: Presidente do TSE derruba 20 postagens contra Lula e proíbe que Flávio e aliados republiquem conteúdo
item.description: The TSE president ordered the removal of 20 fake posts attacking Lula, including one simulating a meeting between Lula and Trump using AI. Flávio Bolsonaro and allies were banned from resharing the content, facing potential electoral violations. The ruling aims to combat disinformation and misuse of AI in the electoral race.

item.title: Kassio dá 3h para remoção de 20 conteúdos contra Lula publicados nas redes
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, head of the TSE, ordered the removal of 20 social media posts attacking Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's image within 3 hours. The ruling targets publications involving figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, Mário Frias, Gustavo Gayer, and Gilvan da Federal, using AI and image manipulation to tarnish the candidate. Lula's federation claimed an organized network with over 1.4 million shared followers.
